playbook.note: Kept in English (masculine) per Weblate glossary and existing translations ('Sélectionner un playbook').

run.note: Noun (a playbook instance): 'exécution' (f.) per Weblate glossary. Existing fr.json inconsistently keeps 'run' or has MT artifacts ('la course') — prefer 'exécution'. Verb 'run a playbook': 'lancer un playbook'.

finish a run.note: Finished: 'terminée'. Existing strings vary ('fin du run', 'Finir la course' — the latter is a mistranslation).

resume a run.note: Restart in this context is also 'reprendre'/'relancer', not 'redémarrer'.

status update.note: Existing rendering. Post update: 'Publier la mise à jour'.

owner.note: Existing rendering. Run owner: 'propriétaire de l'exécution'.

follower.note: Existing rendering ('Suiveurs'); 'abonné' would be more idiomatic but is not the established term here.

action.note: Feminine. Run/Task/Channel Actions: 'actions de l'exécution / de la tâche / du canal'.

metric.note: Feminine; existing majority ('Ajouter une métrique'); 'mesure' appears once — prefer 'métrique'.

due date.note: Existing rendering. No due date: 'Pas de date d'échéance'.

stakeholder.note: Feminine; standard French business term, no established rendering in existing strings.

assignee.note: Existing rendering; avoid the MT artifact 'cessionnaire' found in one existing string.

run channel.note: Create a run channel: 'Créer un canal d'exécution'.

broadcast.note: 'diffuser la mise à jour dans les canaux sélectionnés'; an existing string mistranslates channels as 'chaînes' — always 'canaux'.

section.note: Feminine. Section name: 'nom de la section'.
